fixture: Projectivy home-screen PreviewProbe, A=440 Hz, B=880 Hz; DPAD focus, no Select

method.capture: scrcpy 4.1 device output audio WAV, 48 kHz signed 16-bit PCM
method.toneClassification: nearest 440/880 Hz FFT bins; dominant tone magnitude > 8x competing tone

limitations: Numeric comparison is between separate synthetic PreviewProbe runs, not a controlled test of the code change.
No post-change real AuraMusic song transition was measured.
No B→A sample or repeated-transition latency distribution.

pathApplicability.reason: PreviewProbe is a separate package and does not appear in AuraMusic publishedPrograms(); its A/B focus events cannot exercise the changed AuraMusic prefetch callback.
